hypothesis.claim: Compatibility input aliases and read-only derived fields need an explicit canonical round-trip contract; mismatches must be visible and failed nested validation must occur before persistence.
hypothesis.trigger: alias-only payloads, full detail PUT, conflicting derived summaries, reserved metadata shapes, and built-in analysis sources
hypothesis.expected_baseline: aliases canonicalize but ignored conflicts are accepted and dropped; malformed reserved metadata can fail after save
hypothesis.expected_candidate: editable fields and extensions round-trip, conflicts return structured errors, invalid metadata never writes, and all built-ins round-trip
hypothesis.falsifier: any canonical editable field or extension is lost, a conflicting derived field is silently accepted, or invalid nested metadata leaves a file behind

implementation: compare payload aliases recursively with type-sensitive equality
validate ignored derived fields against canonical component values
allow stale nested summaries only when the component itself changed and is authoritative
validate reserved metadata shape, finite serialization, and string keys before save
allow empty URL only for A_ANALYTICAL sources
add full detail and all-built-in round-trip regressions
activation_checks: parent matrix showed ignored fields accepted then dropped
HTTP alias and full-detail round-trip preserved component, sources, metadata, tags, notes
all 10 built-in component details round-tripped successfully
invalid reserved metadata left no presets.json
conflicting ignored and alias fields returned conflicting_fields
